model.name: Typed pointer aligner
model.note: Two typed-pointer aligners over Latin BERT, one trained on the standard synthetic corpus and one on a corpus whose reused fragments are rewritten word by word, plus a Llama-3.1-8B decoder fine-tuned on the hand-labelled scripts as a second opinion; their cell scores are averaged and decoded one-to-one, and three repairs then apply the annotation's own conventions (spelling variants count as unchanged, a citing formula ends where the quotation begins, a substitution sits in the gap its neighbours leave). Scored on fold 4, which no part of the training saw.
